title: asperula cynanchica var. rupicola
intro: Asperula cynanchica var. rupicola, commonly known as mountain woodruff, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and relieving stress. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in soothing digestive issues and reducing stress levels. The bioactive constituents of mountain woodruff include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
